Feb, 2026

2026 Player Evaluations



    


    

Tryouts/Evaluations Saturday March 7th at:
 

Northmont Middle School 
810 National Rd, Clayton 45315


ALL REGISTERED PLAYERS:  Please see the attached player evaluation schedule. 

All players that are league age 9-14 (registered in Minors, Majors, and Juniors baseball and softball divisions) should plan to attend a minimum of 2 out of the 3 player evaluation dates/times identified for the age/division they are registered in. 

League Age 10 players (registered in the minors divisions) are eligible to be selected to play in either the Majors or Minors divisions.  If league age 10 players (registered in the minors divisions) do not attend at least 2 of the 3 evaluations then they will automatically be placed in the minors divisions.

IF DESIRED, Any players that are league age 8 players (registered in coach pitch) may attend the player evaluations at the noted dates/times in attempt to be drafted up into the Minors divisions.  If league age 8 (coach pitch) players do not attend a minimum of 2 of the 3 identified player evaluation dates / times then they will automatically remain in the coach pitch division.  

Also, New for 2026,
IF DESIRED, Any players that are league age 6 (registered in T-ball) may attend the player evaluations at the noted times in attempt to be evaluated and permitted to play in the coach pitch divisions.  The number of players selected to play up into the coach pitch division is very limited and is based upon ability and potential need for additional players in the coach pitch divisions.  If league age 6 (t-ball division) players do not attend the player evaluations they will automatically remain in the T-ball division that they were registered in.
